page.overview:
Who is Dōshu Goetsu?

Dōshu is a very responsible boy and loyal to his friends.

Dōshu is a young boy with brown hair, bangs that cover his left eye and brown eyes. He wears a green hat, a jumper of same colour, a dark purple vest, a green scarf, blue trousers and ghost blue sandals. After graduating from the Academy, he wears his forehead protector on the right side of his hat.

While still in the Academy, Dōshu became very capable in fūinjutsu and Cooperation Ninjutsu. With the former, he can restrict a person's movements and with both he can expand the might of this alongside fellow users. During missions, he uses chakram restraints he can deploy from a distance. He is also very accurate with a blowgun. Sometime after becoming a genin, he was also trained in medical ninjutsu.

On the day of the entrance ceremony, as everyone began looking for an absent Boruto Uzumaki, he suddenly appeared, crashing a train into the Hokage Monument, which left Dōshu amazed at his antics.
